title: Hunting Dimension: Second Hunt
description: The Hunting Dimension mod, brought back and reimagined!
body:
Do you remember the Hunting Dimension?


 

This mod adds the Hunting Dimension back into Minecraft for modern versions!


Explore a dark and dangerous dimension full of monsters. can you survive to become the top hunter?

 

Original concept and block texture from Darkhax. Support their work n' creations. 

if you're an original author and wish for the mod to be taken down, dm me on discord at phwee and I'll take care of your request.
